message: No detected input validation: There are no schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards on the data loaded from disk; files are directly globbed and loaded without validation.

No detected untrusted source handling: Data is loaded from a hardcoded local path with no checksums, signatures, or remote-source authentication; EfficientNet is fetched via from_pretrained without a pinned revision or checksum.
No detected label flipping detection: No code checks label distributions, validates label values against an expected set, or uses any label-noise detection tool before or during training.
No detected data poisoning defenses: The dataloader and preparation code perform no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious inputs on training samples.

No detected model integrity verification: The code loads pretrained EfficientNet weights via `EfficientNet.from_pretrained('efficientnet-b0')` with no hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision to verify integrity.
No detected label distribution validation: No code checks class balance, validates expected label sets, or detects anomalous samples before or during training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the training loop.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy library (Opacus, TF Privacy, DP-SGD) is imported or used; the optimizer is a standard PyTorch optimizer with no DP wrapping.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART, CleverHans) or manual FGSM/PGD perturbation code is present anywhere in the evaluation pipeline.

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no evidence of a held-out test set isolated from training data, signed/hashed evaluation data, or cross-validation guards; the validator simply iterates over whatever data_loader is passed in without any isolation enforcement.
No detected input sanitization: Inputs are cast to FloatTensor and moved to CUDA directly without any shape, range, or schema validation checks.
No detected output bounds checks: Model logits and derived probabilities are used directly without NaN guards, probability bounds checks, or sanity validation on outputs.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a vision/image classification model (not an LLM), so prompt injection defenses are not applicable.
